rules.rule: Any path that writes a source file and marks it fresh (mark_edited) must also bring its stored rows in line with the new text: shift positions for every symbol in the file, nested ones included, and invalidate files.hash so a later refresh cannot skip it.
Freshness state (fresh_root, fresh_scip_time) must be reset before it is reloaded, and every entry point that refreshes the map must reload it in the running server.
When an external checker or indexer fails to start or exits with an error, keep the previous diagnostics and stamps; only replace them after a successful run.
Child-process helpers in native/ must enforce their timeout on every wait, including after the child closes its output pipes.
